payload.text: hv, 23 Nov 2026, first-hand in vc's session. hv's word: "go". It approves vc's scope for arngz, which answers hv's account of arngz; that account is verbatim in vc's asks to dc and ic of 05:16Z. The rest is vc's wording of what hv accepted. One new arngz thread, going out in the same release as ST0031 (decision 9). WP01, the run log (dc): every run appends to ~/.local/state/arngz/arngz.log. It records each display with its desktops, both as com.apple.spaces records them and as they are live, in order; the plan; each step and what it read back; the outcome and the timings; and the CLI's side (the hs start, the deadline, any kill). It also records each desktop's display at the start and end of a run, every desktop arngz creates, and the time since the last display change, so that cc's likely cause of the surplus desktops can be proved or ruled out: a display that has just attached is short while its own desktops still visit the built-in, so apply creates new ones, and macOS then sends the visitors home. The log adds nothing on screen and is capped in size, and `arngz log` prints the last run. WP02, the toasts (ic): Hammerspoon on-screen alerts. Starting names the desk. Running... shows the current phase. Finished shows the windows placed, already in place and not found, the desktops added or removed, and the time taken, or else the refusal and its reason, and stays up longer. WP03, the desk-change fix (dc, with cc as second reader), starts once the log shows what goes wrong. It covers P.order_spaces' reading of desktop order when desktops move between displays, the refusal's wrong "wait, then run again" advice, the surplus desktops, F3's stale hs client, F4's discover deadline, and decision 9's (5) and (6). hv's diagnosis run: hv switches to the dev tree with utilz use dev, runs zeopit, unplugs, runs rhad, plugs back in and runs zeopit, then switches back with utilz use brew. Each design comes to vc before any code, and every run goes through the Desk.
